scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
Kkkkkkkkk!
I have a special event this Halloween that tests your luck and agility.
Are you interested?
scripts.translation:
[萬聖節魔法師]
Kkkkkkkkk!
這個萬聖節，我準備了一個考驗運氣和身手的特別活動。
有興趣嗎？

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
Come on! Don't be a wuss!
If you collect enough tickets you can get good prizes!
So what do you say?
scripts.translation:
[萬聖節魔法師]
來吧！別這麼膽小！
收集足夠的門票就能獲得不錯的獎品！
那麼，你願意試試嗎？

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
You a 'fraidy cat or something?!
You know you want to try again...
Do you know the rules?
scripts.translation:
[萬聖節魔法師]
你該不會是膽小鬼吧？！
你明明還想再試一次...
你知道規則嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I know.
scripts.translation: 知道

scripts.text: No, I don't know.
scripts.translation: 不知道

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
Oh, well done! You are alright!
Isn't it fun with zombies??
You know, zombies were people too!
Ha!
Kkkkkkk.
scripts.translation:
[萬聖節魔法師]
哦，幹得漂亮！你很不錯！
和腐屍一起是不是很刺激？
要知道，腐屍以前也是人呢！
哈！
Kkkkkkk.

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
As I promised
You can get Halloween tickets for cool items.
scripts.translation:
[萬聖節魔法師]
說到做到，你可以用萬聖節票券兌換好東西。

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
Well, do you want to hear the rules again or, just get back to it...
scripts.translation:
[萬聖節魔法師]
那麼，你是想再聽一遍規則，還是直接開始...

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
This village is like a virtual Payon.
There are zombies and ghouls roaming around and three southern exits, but only one works.
That's up to you to find out.
scripts.translation:
[萬聖節魔法師]
這個村子就像虛擬的斐揚。
到處都遊蕩著腐屍和綠腐屍，南邊有三個出口，但只有一個能通行。
到底是哪個，就靠你自己找了。

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
You can't use any skills to kill the ghouls or zombies.
And one more thing...
you shouldn't forget...
scripts.translation:
[萬聖節魔法師]
你不能用任何技能殺死綠腐屍或腐屍。
還有一件事...千萬別忘了...

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
All participants should be wearing nothing.
Put all belongings in your storage and come back here when your weight is '0'.
scripts.translation:
[萬聖節魔法師]
參加時不能穿戴任何裝備。
把隨身物品都存進倉庫，等負重變成“0”再來。

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
Oh and one more thing!
You can't be riding a PecoPeco or have a Cart.
If you are, then I will remove them before you enter.
Got it?
scripts.translation:
[萬聖節魔法師]
哦，還有！
不能騎大嘴鳥，也不能帶手推車。
否則，入場前我會把它們移除。
明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
Remember, there are three exits but only one works randomly, the zombies and ghouls roaming around there can't be killed and you can't be wearing anything.
scripts.translation:
[萬聖節魔法師]
記住，三個出口中會隨機開放一個，裡面遊蕩的腐屍和綠腐屍都不能殺，而且不能穿戴任何裝備。

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
Hey...
Come back once you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[萬聖節魔法師]
嘿...
準備好了再回來。

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
Ok, you are ready.
Let me check your weight.
scripts.translation:
[萬聖節魔法師]
好，你準備好了。
讓我檢查一下你的負重。

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
Gosh!
There's always a black sheep anywhere.
scripts.translation:
[萬聖節魔法師]
天哪！
哪裡都有害群之馬。

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
You think I wouldn't notice that your weight is above '0'?
You're overweight...
scripts.translation:
[萬聖節魔法師]
你以為我沒注意到你的負重超過“0”嗎？
你超重了...

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
You seem good to go, and your weight is just right.
scripts.translation:
[萬聖節魔法師]
你看起來狀態不錯，負重也剛剛好。

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
I was quite swamped with my work, so I'm exhausted.
scripts.translation:
[萬聖節魔法師]
最近忙得團團轉，真是累壞了。

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
I sometimes forget to send you there...
scripts.translation:
[萬聖節魔法師]
我有時會忘記把你傳送過去...

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
I hope you come back well.
scripts.translation:
[萬聖節魔法師]
希望你能平安回來。

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
You want to exchange tickets for prizes?
Good job! Kkkkkk!
scripts.translation:
[萬聖節魔法師]
想用票券換獎品嗎？
幹得不錯！Kkkkkk!

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
Lemme tell you what items you can exchange for.
scripts.translation:
[萬聖節魔法師]
讓我告訴你可以用票券兌換哪些物品。

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
5 tickets for Pumpkin Pie.
20 tickets for Pumpkin-Head.
50 tickets for Old Blue Box.
70 tickets for Old Purple Box.
200 tickets for Old Card Album.
scripts.translation:
[萬聖節魔法師]
5張票券兌換南瓜派。
20張票券兌換南瓜帽子。
50張票券兌換神秘箱子。
70張票券兌換神秘紫箱。
200張票券兌換老舊 收集冊。

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
What would you like to exchange for?
scripts.translation:
[萬聖節魔法師]
你想兌換什麼？

scripts.text: Pumpkin Pie
scripts.translation: 南瓜派

scripts.text: Pumpkin-Head
scripts.translation: 南瓜帽子

scripts.text: Old Blue Box
scripts.translation: 神秘箱子

scripts.text: Old Purple Box
scripts.translation: 神秘紫箱

scripts.text: Old Card Album
scripts.translation: 老舊 收集冊

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
Ok, see you then.
Kkkkkkkk.
scripts.translation:
[萬聖節魔法師]
好，那回頭見。
Kkkkkkkk.

scripts.text: Explain it to me.
scripts.translation: 說明規則

scripts.text: I want to participate.
scripts.translation: 我要參加

scripts.text: I want to exchange tickets for prizes.
scripts.translation: 兌換獎品

scripts.text: I'll come back next time.
scripts.translation: 下次再來

scripts.text: Get me back there now!
scripts.translation: 現在就送我回去

scripts.text: Please, tell me the rules
scripts.translation: 說明規則

scripts.text: I want to exchange tickets for prizes.
scripts.translation: 兌換獎品

scripts.text: I'll come back next time.
scripts.translation: 下次再來

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
You don't have enough tickets!
Can't you even count?
Please come here with the right number of tickets.
scripts.translation:
[萬聖節魔法師]
你的票券不夠！
你連數數都不會嗎？
請帶著正確數量的票券再來。

scripts.text:
[Halloween Magician]
Here it is.
Do you need...
anything else?
scripts.translation:
[萬聖節魔法師]
給你。
還需要...別的東西嗎？
